title: HS60016: Performance Management
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Course Content
Performance management: the challenge of performance management, performance
management as a system; performance planning, on-going performance
communication; Approaches to performance evaluation: performance appraisal
meeting, performance diagnosis and improvement, performance management and
discipline; Performance management variations; People process: people
technique, performance management in action.
